release.notes: v1 — nine seed papers, agent-extracted (stated_claims_v3_agent); one paper prints no abstract and yields no claims by the anchor rule; all records unverified pending human review; vocabularies cause/effect v1; cross-check vs the tables dataset frozen.

concepts.label: Import competition
concepts.rationale: This represents a macroeconomic trade shock, specifically from the dismantling of import quotas.
concepts.definition: The level of competition faced by domestic firms from foreign imports.
concepts.more_means: greater exposure to foreign import competition

concepts.label: Liquidity constraints
concepts.rationale: Liquidity constraints limit the ability of agents to smooth consumption or intertemporally shift income.
concepts.definition: The inability of individuals or firms to access liquid funds or credit.
concepts.more_means: more severely constrained liquidity

concepts.label: Having children
concepts.rationale: These phrases all capture the extensive or intensive margin of having children and their arrival in the family.
concepts.definition: The presence, arrival, or number of children in a household.
concepts.more_means: having more children or experiencing childbirth

concepts.label: Maternal grandparents' relative labor supply
concepts.rationale: This is a specific family background variable capturing the intergenerational transmission of child penalties.
concepts.definition: The labor supply of maternal grandparents relative to paternal grandparents, proxying childhood environment.
concepts.more_means: higher relative labor supply of maternal grandparents

concepts.label: Parental death
concepts.rationale: This captures the event of losing a parent, which acts as a sudden family health and psychological shock.
concepts.definition: The sudden death of a parent, representing a severe family bereavement shock.
concepts.more_means: experiencing a parental death

concepts.label: Health shock
concepts.rationale: Parent concept for categorizing fatal and nonfatal health shocks.
concepts.definition: A sudden, severe deterioration in the health status of a family member.
concepts.more_means: experiencing a severe health shock

concepts.label: Fatal health shock
concepts.rationale: This specifically captures lethal health shocks that result in the death of a family member.
concepts.definition: A health shock resulting in the death of a family member (e.g., spouse).
concepts.more_means: experiencing a fatal health shock in the family

concepts.label: Severe nonfatal health shock
concepts.rationale: This captures severe health shocks where the family member survives, allowing researchers to isolate the non-fatal channel.
concepts.definition: A severe but non-lethal health shock experienced by a family member.
concepts.more_means: experiencing a severe nonfatal health shock

concepts.label: Tax audit enforcement
concepts.rationale: Both prior audits and threat-of-audit letters represent active tax enforcement mechanisms designed to increase compliance.
concepts.definition: The active enforcement of tax compliance through audits or threats of audits.
concepts.more_means: higher probability or presence of tax audits or audit threats

concepts.label: Firm willingness to cooperate in tax shifting
concepts.rationale: This captures the supply side of tax avoidance, where firms facilitate or block shifting behavior.
concepts.definition: The inclination of employers to assist employees in shifting income to reduce tax liability.
concepts.more_means: firms are more willing to cooperate in shifting behavior

concepts.label: Marginal tax rate
concepts.rationale: Marginal tax rate and net-of-tax rate are mirror images of the same tax schedule. A tax reform reducing marginal tax rates is a negative shock to the marginal tax rate.
concepts.definition: The tax rate imposed on the last dollar of taxable income.
concepts.more_means: higher marginal tax rates

concepts.label: Marginal tax rate on capital income
concepts.rationale: A sub-concept of marginal tax rates specifically targeting capital income, measured here as the net-of-tax rate (mirror image).
concepts.definition: The marginal tax rate applied specifically to capital income.
concepts.more_means: higher marginal tax rate on capital income

concepts.label: Marginal tax rate on labor income
concepts.rationale: A sub-concept of marginal tax rates specifically targeting labor income, measured here as the net-of-tax rate (mirror image).
concepts.definition: The marginal tax rate applied specifically to labor earnings.
concepts.more_means: higher marginal tax rate on labor income

concepts.label: Tax salience
concepts.rationale: Tax salience is a cognitive factor influencing how taxpayers perceive and respond to tax rates.
concepts.definition: The visibility or prominence of tax liabilities to taxpayers.
concepts.more_means: taxes are more salient to the taxpayer

concepts.label: Female child penalty in earnings
concepts.rationale: A specific dynamic gap measure capturing the earnings penalty associated with motherhood.
concepts.definition: The long-run negative impact of having children on women's earnings relative to men's.
concepts.more_means: a larger child penalty on female earnings

concepts.label: Gender gap in earnings
concepts.rationale: A between-group inequality metric tracking the overall gender earnings gap.
concepts.definition: The difference in earnings between male and female workers.
concepts.more_means: a larger earnings gap between men and women

concepts.label: Probability of working in a family-friendly firm for women relative to men
concepts.rationale: A relative firm-type choice metric tracking sorting into family-friendly workplaces.
concepts.definition: The likelihood of women working in family-friendly environments compared to men.
concepts.more_means: higher relative probability of women working in family-friendly firms

concepts.label: Gender gap in hours worked
concepts.rationale: A between-group inequality metric tracking differences in intensive-margin labor supply.
concepts.definition: The difference in hours worked between male and female workers.
concepts.more_means: a larger gap in hours worked between men and women

concepts.label: Probability of becoming manager for women relative to men
concepts.rationale: A relative career progression metric tracking leadership attainment.
concepts.definition: The likelihood of a female worker attaining a managerial position relative to a male worker.
concepts.more_means: higher relative probability of women becoming managers

concepts.label: Occupational rank of women relative to men
concepts.rationale: A relative occupational status metric comparing women to men.
concepts.definition: The relative standing or prestige of women's occupations compared to men's.
concepts.more_means: higher occupational rank of women relative to men

concepts.label: Gender gap in labor participation
concepts.rationale: A between-group inequality metric tracking differences in extensive-margin labor supply.
concepts.definition: The difference in labor force participation rates between men and women.
concepts.more_means: a larger participation gap between men and women

concepts.label: Probability of working in the public sector for women relative to men
concepts.rationale: A relative sector sorting metric tracking public vs. private employment.
concepts.definition: The likelihood of women being employed in the public sector compared to men.
concepts.more_means: higher relative probability of women working in the public sector

concepts.label: Gender gap in wage rates
concepts.rationale: A between-group inequality metric tracking differences in hourly compensation.
concepts.definition: The difference in hourly wage rates between male and female workers.
concepts.more_means: a larger wage rate gap between men and women

concepts.label: Mental health prescriptions
concepts.rationale: Measures medical treatment of mental health conditions via prescription drugs.
concepts.definition: Prescriptions filled for psychiatric or mental health conditions.
concepts.more_means: more prescriptions for mental health conditions

concepts.label: Opioid prescriptions
concepts.rationale: Measures prescription drug use specifically for pain management/opioids.
concepts.definition: Prescriptions filled for opioid medications.
concepts.more_means: more opioid prescriptions

concepts.label: Use of psychological assistance
concepts.rationale: Measures healthcare utilization related to mental health counseling.
concepts.definition: Utilization of mental health services and psychological counseling.
concepts.more_means: more frequent use of psychological assistance

concepts.label: Capital income
concepts.rationale: Capital income is distinct from labor income.
concepts.definition: Income derived from capital assets and investments.
concepts.more_means: higher capital income

concepts.label: Hourly earnings
concepts.rationale: Hourly earnings is a distinct intensive-margin wage rate variable.
concepts.definition: The rate of labor earnings per hour worked.
concepts.more_means: higher hourly wage rate

concepts.label: Household post-transfer income
concepts.rationale: A household-level post-policy income metric, distinct from individual labor earnings.
concepts.definition: Total household income after accounting for government transfers and benefits.
concepts.more_means: higher household disposable income

concepts.label: Labor income
concepts.rationale: Both phrases refer to the total earnings or income generated from employment.
concepts.definition: Earnings and income derived from labor market work.
concepts.more_means: higher labor earnings

concepts.label: Taxable income
concepts.rationale: Taxable income is the broad base of income subject to taxation.
concepts.definition: The amount of income subject to personal income tax.
concepts.more_means: higher total taxable income

concepts.label: Self-reported taxable income
concepts.rationale: Distinguished by the paper from third-party reported income due to different evasion opportunities.
concepts.definition: Taxable income that is self-reported by the taxpayer rather than third-party verified.
concepts.more_means: higher self-reported income

concepts.label: Third-party reported taxable income
concepts.rationale: Distinguished from self-reported income because third-party reporting leaves little room for evasion.
concepts.definition: Taxable income reported directly to tax authorities by third parties such as employers.
concepts.more_means: higher third-party reported income

concepts.label: Employment in high-wage occupations
concepts.rationale: An occupational choice outcome tracking employment in high-paying jobs.
concepts.definition: Employment in occupations classified in the top tier of the wage distribution.
concepts.more_means: higher probability of working in a high-wage occupation

concepts.label: Employment in low-wage occupations
concepts.rationale: An occupational choice outcome tracking employment in low-paying jobs.
concepts.definition: Employment in occupations classified in the bottom tier of the wage distribution.
concepts.more_means: higher probability of working in a low-wage occupation

concepts.label: Employment in mid-wage occupations
concepts.rationale: An occupational choice outcome tracking employment in middle-tier jobs.
concepts.definition: Employment in occupations classified in the middle tier of the wage distribution.
concepts.more_means: higher probability of working in a mid-wage occupation

concepts.label: Hours worked
concepts.rationale: Represents the intensive margin of labor supply.
concepts.definition: The number of hours worked in a given period (typically weekly).
concepts.more_means: more hours worked

concepts.label: Labor force participation
concepts.rationale: Represents the extensive margin of labor supply.
concepts.definition: Whether an individual is active in the labor force (employed or actively seeking work).
concepts.more_means: higher probability of participating in the labor force

concepts.label: Tax avoidance
concepts.rationale: Legal behavioral responses to tax schedules, distinct from illegal evasion.
concepts.definition: Legal methods used to minimize the amount of income tax owed.
concepts.more_means: more legal tax avoidance

concepts.label: Tax evasion
concepts.rationale: Illegal non-compliance, distinct from legal tax avoidance.
concepts.definition: Illegal non-payment or underpayment of tax, specifically on self-reported income.
concepts.more_means: more tax evasion

concepts.label: Tax shifting behavior
concepts.rationale: A general concept for behavioral tax optimization through shifting.
concepts.definition: Behavioral responses aimed at shifting income across tax categories or periods to minimize tax liability.
concepts.more_means: more active tax shifting

concepts.label: Intertemporal tax shifting
concepts.rationale: A specific sub-type of tax shifting focused on the timing of income realization.
concepts.definition: Shifting the timing of income realization across tax years to exploit tax rate differentials.
concepts.more_means: more intertemporal shifting of income
